name: Claude Max

reset.rule: The window opens with your first message and resets in full 5 hours later.
stipulations: claude.ai, Claude Code, Desktop and IDE use all count toward the same window.
On Max, a response in progress may finish after the limit ("wrapping up"). That overrun counts toward the weekly limit.

reset.rule: Resets at a fixed day and time assigned to your account.
stipulations: The reset time doesn't move when you start using Claude or when your subscription renews.
Fable draws from the regular weekly limit and uses it faster than other Claude models.
Fable can use at most 50% of the weekly limit. The meter shows how much of that 50% you've used.

resets.label: Fable 5.2 launch limit resets

count.rule: 1 if you've subscribed under 6 months, 2 for 6–12 months, 3 for over 12 months, counted from your first paid bill.

resets.howTo: Settings → Usage → Limit resets → Reset for free
stipulations: Only for accounts with paid billing before 9 Nov 2026, 10:00 am PT.
Restores Fable usage on the weekly limit and refills the 5-hour window. It doesn't raise any limit.
Best used right after you hit a limit early in a week.

overage: Blocked at the limit unless you turn on usage credits (Settings → Usage). Credits bill at API rates up to a monthly cap you set. Credits bought from 7 Dec 2026 expire 12 months after purchase. Monthly API credits included with Max can't pay for this.

how: A 5-hour session window and a weekly window across all models.
Fable models have their own cap inside the weekly window: at most 50% of it.
Every Claude surface draws from the same limits.
Claude Code has a 25% higher weekly limit since 14 Sep 2026.
Includes $100 a month of API credits for the Claude API. They can't pay for usage over your plan limits.
ext: Claude models only. To use Claude on another plan's quota, use Antigravity (Google) or OpenCode Go (Haiku 5.5).
quirks: If ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set in your environment, Claude Code bills the API instead of your plan.
Verified Ultra accounts ($200) have no 5-hour limit. Max 5x keeps both limits.
Anthropic renamed Max 5x to Max on 30 Oct 2026, when Max 20x became Ultra.
card.alert: Unused promo: 1–3 free Fable limit resets, expiring 8 Mar 2027.

events.what: Usage credits bought from this date expire 12 months after purchase.
Fable 5.2 launch limit resets expire at 11:59 pm PT.
One free full limit reset (all models) for Pro, Max, Ultra and Team expires at 2:00 pm PT. Look for it under Settings → Usage → Limit resets.
